name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 10 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 10 hours starting 2025-08-13, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.22 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
